title: MumWell companion
welcomeBody: This is a safe space to share whatever is on your mind, big or small. How are you feeling today?
starters: I can't sleep, even when the baby sleeps
I feel guilty all the time
I just need someone to talk to
hint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
privacy: Conversations are deleted automatically 24 hours after your last message.
missing: This conversation is no longer available. For your privacy, conversations are deleted 24 hours after the last message.
